purpose: Use the originator-supplied CD169 native PRISM vehicle-navigation provenance as a real-world calibration corpus for future KUSTO synthetic forward models while preserving Synthetic-v1 as an immutable baseline and forbidding CD169 from serving as independent V2 validation.

source_policy.reason: Preserve provenance and reproducibility without republishing externally supplied source bytes.

frozen_baselines.rule: Neither historical artifact may be rewritten after native veh_nav inspection.

calibration_questions: How large is the error between sparse science-log TOBI positions and the native PRISM vehicle-navigation product?
How large and how directional is the error of the frozen Line-19 straight interpolation against native vehicle navigation?
Does the frozen Synthetic-v1 rounding-only Monte Carlo envelope contain the native navigation?
How far is the old V2 reconstructed target vehicle position from the native vehicle position at the same epoch?
Which real error components must be represented in future synthetic nuisance models?

calibration_inputs: existing raw TOBI altitude/heading/cable context already frozen in KUSTO
forbidden_outputs: scientific validation score on CD169 after fitting

promotion_rule: Synthetic-v2 is methodologically improved only if a preregistered unseen-real validation shows lower error than Synthetic-v1 on the same metrics; CD169 fit quality alone cannot establish improvement.
